primary_estimand: Macro-F1 of the exact frozen logistic system minus macro-F1 of the exact frozen served random-forest system, paired on all eligible single-label cases in the precommitted complete prospective assay source frame, at that frame's observed class prevalence.
margin_interpretation: An operational research-value threshold, not an established biological or clinical minimum important difference.

cohort_gates.interpretation: Feasibility floors, not power guarantees or class quotas. A separate dated source-frame commitment and precision justification are mandatory before annotation. No outcome-driven expansion.

support.length_basis: Observed minimum and maximum of the frozen 1741-protein development cohort, computed before external recruitment; this is not proof of multivariate support.
support.detection_breadth_required: Evidence sufficient to distinguish the five target compartments in a named biological context; a single positive organelle assay with unobserved alternatives is partial evidence.

Membrane: Cell surface with demonstrated plasma membrane association
Secreted: Demonstrated extracellular secretion of the assayed protein

label_rules: Keep every supported location as a set; never resolve Cytoplasm/Nucleus by priority or probability.
Generic membrane, ER, Golgi, lysosome, peroxisome, vesicles, ambiguous nuclear envelope and unspecified cytoplasmic organelles remain other_locations or unresolved.
A signal peptide, extracellular database term, serum detection or conditioned-medium detection without lysis controls does not establish secretion.
Secretory transit alone does not add a stable ER/Golgi localization; demonstrated residence or context-dependent localization must be retained.
Missing measurements are not negative labels. Single-label means one adequately supported target in the predeclared context, never global biological exclusivity.
Isoform-specific or processed-fragment localization is outside primary unless the assay-to-exact-native-sequence relationship is unambiguous; never substitute a mature fragment for model input.

annotation.review_scope: All external cases; all 2107 accepted internal records in a separate audit, ensuring every known Cytoplasm/Nucleus disagreement and note-bearing record is included.
annotation.post_unblinding: Audit every external Cytoplasm/Nucleus disagreement with a separate blinded review team and decoys; archive original labels unchanged. Any revised-label analysis is explicitly secondary and cannot replace the primary endpoint.

homology.history_universe: All 2107 accepted development and historical-related proteins, including all 1822 original baseline proteins
homology.bridge_universe: 20431 frozen source sequences, including curation-rejected proteins
homology.sequence_search: MMseqs2 all-versus-all, sensitivity 7.5, E<=0.001 retrieval, alignment mode 3, low-complexity masking and composition correction, target-count output capacity; symmetrize accepted edges and use connected components.
homology.remote_domains: Mandatory Pfam/profile audit on both cohorts using one pinned database release and gathering thresholds; shared confidently assigned family with >=50 aligned residues and >=50% profile coverage is excluded from primary. Shared clans, repeats, low-complexity matches and uncertain domain evidence require blinded expert review; unresolved dependence is nonprimary. Record all assignments, including no-hits, and justify homology decisions.
homology.optional_remote_sensitivity: Precommit structure/profile-profile search versions and databases before annotation if used. No remote relationship may be declared absent merely because a tool is unavailable.
homology.within_external: Union gene, exact/close/local/remote family, study/raw-data, assay-run and batch dependence; same component must remain intact in uncertainty analysis.
homology.limitations: Finite sequence/profile searches do not prove absence of evolutionary relatedness. Generalization is conditional on the declared screening sensitivity.

independence.date_definition: First acquisition of underlying assay data strictly after prospective_cutoff, not database update or publication date
exclusions: same gene or unresolved gene mapping
shared supporting publication, preprint, DOI or reused raw assay dataset
independence.older_assay_separated_data: Separate future secondary protocol only; never substitute or pool it into this primary test when recruitment fails.
independence.source_frame_commitment: Freeze named sites/sources, acquisition end, census inclusion, context/sequence rules, dependency metadata and precision justification in an independently timestamped recruitment-plan before annotation.

bootstrap.method: Paired percentile bootstrap of joint dependence components, retaining all proteins and both fixed-model predictions in sampled components
bootstrap.missing_class_replicates: Keep and count all replicates; fixed five-class macro average with zero F1 for absent-class zero denominators; no redrawing.
bootstrap.scope: Conditional uncertainty for these frozen systems and the specified cohort/assay sampling process, not training or annotation uncertainty

primary_decisions.interval_upper_le_zero: Overturns transport of the apparent gain to this external population; does not erase the historical internal observation
primary_decisions.interval_upper_lt_0_03: Rules out the prespecified material external gain
primary_decisions.interval_lower_gt_0_03: Supports material gain for these frozen systems in this primary population
primary_decisions.interval_lower_gt_zero: Supports positive gain, material magnitude uncertain
primary_decisions.otherwise: Inconclusive; gain is not independently confirmed
primary_decisions.invalid_uncertainty_or_cohort: No confirmatory claim; report failed feasibility/precision gates without relaxing them

secondary_descriptive: absolute and per-class F1, recall, specificity, confusion matrices
AUROC, average precision, log loss, multiclass Brier, ten-bin reliability
multilocalized top-1 membership in the supported location set, not complete multilabel accuracy
coverage and every exclusion by source/context and adjudicated class
leave-one-joint-component-out paired differences and sign reversals
unresolved and other-compartment strata as missing/unsupported outcomes, not negatives
all Cytoplasm/Nucleus disagreements and note-dependent cases reviewed without altering the primary truth
multiple_comparisons: One primary paired interval. All other metrics, subgroups, relabeling sensitivities and third-party predictor comparisons are descriptive, with no secondary confirmatory p-values.
external_predictors: Defer execution until compatible semantics, output rules, exact version, training-label/sequence release and homologous/remote/pretraining overlaps are documented. Use native thresholds frozen beforehand; do not renormalize ten independent multilabel probabilities into a five-class softmax. Unknown training overlap means a contaminated-or-unknown descriptive comparison, never independent SOTA evidence.
wet_lab_status: No new endogenous localization assay or wet-lab outcome has been produced. Annotation adjudication is evidence assessment only.
change_control: No retraining, tuning, recalibration, threshold selection, label repair or source replacement using external predictions. Any substantive amendment requires a dated pre-unblinding record and new cohort if outcomes were accessed. Never rerun this primary study to select a favorable result.
